title: Algebraic Stories — Hilbert functions of fat points.
exact_target: Determine every multigraded Hilbert-function value for equally thickened generic points in a product of projective spaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1500015 (AMR-014-0015). CC BY 4.0.
R. Fröberg, S. Lundqvist, A. Oneto and B. Shapiro, \emph{Algebraic Stories from One and from the Other Pockets}, arXiv:1801.01692 (2018), §3.1, Problem J.
